# Email

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/writing/email.md`.

- MAIL-01 lean: Open with the point after the salutation; add a pleasantry only in a reply.
- MAIL-02 lean: State identifiers, dates and time windows explicitly, and offer availability as a list.
- MAIL-03 lean: Keep paragraphs to 1 to 3 sentences, ask one thing per paragraph, and number the questions when there are two or more.
- MAIL-04 lean: Report a defect or complaint neutrally: situation, expected versus actual, concrete request; no blame or emotion words.
- MAIL-05 lean: Use no bold or italics in plain-text mail; em dashes follow PRIN-11.
- MAIL-06 lean: Apologize only for a real own error, once and briefly.
